digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler, live Jira Data Center integration
propositions: The reconciler must be proven against a realistic store copy to surface ordering and field-mapping defects that an empty store cannot expose
Isolation requires both a separate git repo with no remotes AND removal of reconciler artifacts (bindings, snapshots) so the reconciler cannot write to production Jira
Inbound and outbound mutations must each round-trip through a DC instance with oracles that assert the exact value written and read back, not merely that no exception escaped
A complete store copy requires count matching between the filesystem under .tickets-tracker/ and the fetched tickets branch, excluding dot-files
Multi-page pagination must be tested by seeding issues to force at least three page fetches and asserting the effective server page size is observed
